name: A frustrated request makes Boop determined
case: A turn fails its tests and ends. The person starts the next turn sounding fed up: it's still broken. Boop takes their side and roots for the retry: its mood turns determined, with a determined face. It isn't grumpy at them or sad.
why: plan/steering/guide.md: a turn isn't routine when what you asked carries a clear feeling; plan/steering/mood/happy.md: happy leaves for determined when what you asked sounds frustrated; PERSONALITY's Examples: a frustrated request is determined, "again", once
